summary: Iteration 4 (admin full CRUD + simplified categories + ChipInput) tested end-to-end. Backend: 74/74 pytest passing (26 backend_test.py + 14 test_iteration3.py + 22 test_iteration4.py). Frontend: 11 admin tabs render, ChipInput add/remove/edit-prefill works, course-form category dropdown only shows the 5 allowed cats, /courses public filter buttons match [All, NEET, IIT-JEE, Foundation, CBSE, JKBOSE], /scholarship target_exam options match the 5-cat list, CourseDetail 'What you get' section renders course.features chips on the CBSE seed course.

minor.issue: Seed is non-idempotent for the new `features`/`syllabus`/`faculty` arrays — pre-existing courses from iteration 2/3 (NEET, IIT-JEE, Foundation seed titles) were inserted before these fields existed and the seed only inserts courses by missing title; it does NOT backfill arrays on already-present rows. Result: only freshly-inserted seed rows (CBSE, JKBOSE) currently have features. Public CourseDetail 'What you get' will be silent for those legacy rows. Recommend either bumping titles, or upserting the arrays for existing matching titles.

Seed only fires when centers count == 0. After admin-driven deletes (or tests that delete centers) the seed will not restore the original 6 Kashmir centers — only the remaining ones are visible. Currently 4 centers in DB. Not a bug, just a documentation note.

action_items: Recommend: in seed(), after the 'find_one by title' check, also $set syllabus/faculty/features for existing matching titles so legacy NEET/IIT-JEE/Foundation seed courses gain the new chip arrays without needing a manual re-seed.
Optional: re-seed the 6 Kashmir centers when count < 6 instead of == 0, or expose a seed-rerun admin endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~790 lines and contains all routes — split into routers/<domain>.py (auth, courses, admin, uploads) before any further iteration; this iteration alone added 15+ admin endpoints.

All admin CRUD endpoints (centers, testimonials, results, scholarships) re-use the same model for create AND update. PUT requires the full body; consider PATCH or making fields Optional in *Update models so the admin UI can do partial saves.
ALLOWED_CATEGORIES is duplicated as both a Literal in CourseIn and a Python list — keep one source of truth (Literal.__args__ or pydantic enum) and derive the cleanup query from it.

Course PUT does not re-validate uniqueness/anything else; that's fine, but PUT of a non-existent id silently returns null today (update_course raises 404 only on POST/match=0; check db.courses.find_one after update may return None — verify in test).
ChipInput uses Backspace to delete the trailing chip without a confirm — friendly UX but make sure tab order doesn't trap focus in the chip list.
AdminDashboard.jsx is a single 600+ line file with 11 tabs of forms — extract each tab into its own component (CoursesTab.jsx, CentersTab.jsx, ...) for maintainability.
